description: Mythos Solution Patterns — known compositions of chunks that solve categories of problems. Claude picks a pattern, fills in the specifics, Ollama grinds through the build plan.

data_query_skill.name: Data Query Skill
data_query_skill.description: Reads from one PostgreSQL table, returns structured data + human summary. The most common pattern — accounts for ~70% of skills.

methods.name: execute
methods.purpose: Main entry — extract params, run query, format, return

methods.name: _build_query
methods.purpose: Construct the SQL from request parameters

methods.name: _format_results
methods.purpose: Turn rows into structured data dict

methods.name: _build_summary
methods.purpose: Turn rows into human-readable summary string

build_plan_template.instruction: Write imports, _get_conn(), class skeleton with all SkillBase attributes
Write execute() tying it all together with try/except/finally

memory_search.name: Memory Search
memory_search.description: Full-text search across one or more memory stores (voice memos, conversations, life events, ideas). Extracts search terms, queries with tsvector or ILIKE, ranks results, returns summary.

methods.name: execute
methods.purpose: Extract search terms, optionally route to stores, search, rank, format

methods.name: _extract_search_terms
methods.purpose: Pull keywords/phrases from natural language message

methods.name: _search_store
methods.purpose: Run FTS or ILIKE query against a specific table

methods.name: _rank_results
methods.purpose: Score by relevance + recency, sort

methods.name: _build_summary
methods.purpose: Human-readable summary of top results with previews

build_plan_template.instruction: Write execute() chaining all methods with try/except/finally

action_skill.name: Action Skill
action_skill.description: Writes to PostgreSQL (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE), returns confirmation. Used for logging events, creating records, updating state.

methods.name: execute
methods.purpose: Parse input, validate, write, confirm

methods.name: _parse_input
methods.purpose: Extract structured data from natural language message

methods.name: _validate
methods.purpose: Check required fields, prevent duplicates

methods.name: _write
methods.purpose: Execute INSERT/UPDATE with parameterized query

methods.name: _build_confirmation
methods.purpose: Human-readable confirmation of what was done

build_plan_template.instruction: Write _parse_input() — extract structured data from message

composite_skill.name: Composite Skill
composite_skill.description: Chains 2+ existing skills together. Daily briefing, full search across stores, multi-step workflows.

methods.name: execute
methods.purpose: Run sub-skills, collect results, merge summaries

methods.name: _run_sub_skills
methods.purpose: Import and execute each sub-skill

methods.name: _merge_results
methods.purpose: Combine data dicts and summaries from all sub-skills

build_plan_template.instruction: Write class skeleton with imports for all sub-skills
Write _run_sub_skills() calling each sub-skill via await Skill().run()

api_endpoint.name: API Endpoint
api_endpoint.description: FastAPI route that exposes a skill or direct query via HTTP. Includes request validation, response formatting, error handling.

methods.name: route_handler
methods.purpose: FastAPI route function

methods.name: _validate_request
methods.purpose: Pydantic model or manual validation

methods.name: _execute
methods.purpose: Call skill or run query directly

Write the handler logic calling the appropriate skill or query

telegram_command.name: Telegram Command
telegram_command.description: Bot handler responding to a /command. Parses args, calls a skill, formats reply for Telegram.

methods.name: handle_command
methods.purpose: Entry point called by bot dispatcher

methods.name: _parse_args
methods.purpose: Extract arguments from message text

methods.name: _execute
methods.purpose: Call skill or run query

methods.name: _format_reply
methods.purpose: Format for Telegram (markdown, length limits)
